# Source watch list

<!-- Generated by scripts/source_impact.py from docs/maintenance/sources.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every source the kit's content relies on, the exact edition currently mapped, where the official text lives, who looks after it and how often it is re-checked. The process for acting on a change is in [`MAINTENANCE.md`](../../MAINTENANCE.md). To see what a change touches, run `python3 scripts/source_impact.py list --framework "<name>"`.

**"Last checked" says what was actually looked at.** A date next to "page title only" is not a review of the content. A source that has never been checked says so.

## General Data Protection Regulation

- **Id:** `gdpr` · **Type:** law · **Mapped framework:** GDPR
- **Edition currently mapped:** Regulation (EU) 2016/679
- **Official URL:** https://publications.europa.eu/resource/celex/32016R0679. Fetched on 2026-10-09 (Publications Office edition, English). EUR-Lex itself returned an empty bot-challenge page.
- **Last checked:** 2026-10-09. Articles 3, 4(7), 4(8), 4(12), 5, 12(3), 24, 25, 27, 28, 30, 32, 33, 34, 35 and 36(1) read in full or in the relevant paragraphs; Chapter V (Articles 44 to 49) read in full on 2026-10-12; titles of Articles 12 to 23 and 50 only.
- **Owner (role):** privacy contact (a maintainer) · **Review cadence:** At least yearly, and on any announced amendment
- **Documents that rely on it:** [`privacy/README.md`](../../privacy/README.md), [`privacy/dpia-screening.md`](../../privacy/dpia-screening.md), [`privacy/data-subject-requests.md`](../../privacy/data-subject-requests.md), [`privacy/international-transfers.md`](../../privacy/international-transfers.md), [`privacy/international-transfers-example.md`](../../privacy/international-transfers-example.md), [`privacy/record-of-processing.md`](../../privacy/record-of-processing.md), [`scoping/gdpr-territorial-scope.md`](../../scoping/gdpr-territorial-scope.md), [`runbooks/incident-response.md`](../../runbooks/incident-response.md), [`runbooks/tabletop-incident-notification.md`](../../runbooks/tabletop-incident-notification.md)
- **Notes:** Articles 15 to 22 beyond titles have not been read. Article 47 (binding corporate rules) and Article 50 were not relied on in detail.

## Commission Recommendation 2003/361/EC concerning the definition of micro, small and medium-sized enterprises

- **Id:** `recommendation-2003-361` · **Type:** law · **Mapped framework:** none (cited, not mapped)

- **Official URL:** https://publications.europa.eu/resource/celex/32003H0361. Fetched on 2026-10-12 (Publications Office PDF, English). It is a recommendation, not binding law; NIS2 Art. 2(1) makes its Annex the size test.
- **Last checked:** 2026-10-12. Annex Articles 2 and 3 (ceilings, partner and linked enterprises, Art. 3(4)) and the titles of Articles 4 to 6.

- **Notes:** Articles 4 to 6 (data, reference period, staff headcount rules) were not read. Cited only as the size test referred to by NIS2 Art. 2(1).
